$comment: Every export of @akshayanimateddsa/visual-lab, one line each (test/catalogue.test.js checks this list against the code). Views: `el` + `update(state, ctx)`; their state shapes are in each file's header.

views.ArrayView: An array: cells, values, tones, pointers, sliding windows, floating values, arc arrows; moves by id.
views.GraphView: A graph: fixed or circular vertex positions; directed, weighted, curved, parallel and self-loop edges.
views.TreeView: A rooted tree (binary keeps left/right sides; n-ary by leaf order), laid out automatically; trie rings.
views.CallTreeView: A recursion tree: calls appear in fixed slots as they happen, memo hits as dashed links, a note over the root.
views.NodeLinkView: The node-edge engine the graph, tree and call tree use: shapes, tones, edges, pointers, icons, badges, tweened geometry.

helpers.edgeKey: The edgeTones key of an edge between two vertices (directed or not).
helpers.undirectedKey: The id of an undirected edge, the same either way round.
helpers.normalizePointers: Pointer state in short or long form to a list ready to draw.
helpers.pointerColor: A pointer's colour from its tone or its name (i, left, mid, slow…).
helpers.pointerOffset: The y offset of a stacked pointer at a level.
helpers.pointersHeight: The height taken by stacked pointer rows.
helpers.POINTER_ROW: Height of each stacked pointer name row (px).
helpers.POINTER_EDGE: Room kept at each side for a pointer name wider than its cell (px).
helpers.MOTIONS: The motion profiles: Crisp, Smooth, Bouncy (scale, easing, CSS easing).
helpers.spring: An underdamped spring easing that settles by t = 1.
helpers.cssLinear: A CSS linear() easing sampled from an easing function.
helpers.setMotionEase: Sets where tweens read their easing from (a site's motion setting).
helpers.tween: A numeric tween for SVG geometry, eased with the motion in use; returns cancel.
helpers.h: Creates an HTML element with attributes and children.
helpers.s: Creates an SVG element with attributes and children.
helpers.replayClass: Restarts a one-shot CSS animation class.
helpers.syncKeyed: Keyed reconciliation of children so CSS transitions animate moves, enters and leaves.
helpers.playEnter: Animates an element in from its is-entering styles.
helpers.withoutTransitions: Runs a re-layout with CSS transitions off.

css.css/tokens.css: Default design tokens (colours, fonts, timing, view colours), the .tone-* vocabulary and .no-anim.
